title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
   

  

**Function:** 
 DEAI Hitachi Vantara
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 R0136284
   

  

**Our Company**
 We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers \- from banks to theme parks \- can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate \- and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team \- and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable
 **Solutions Engineer** 
 to bridge the gap between complex cloud infrastructure technologies and real\-world customer solutions. In this role, you will design, build, and implementation\-test cutting\-edge platform architectures that blend traditional virtualization with modern cloud\-native ecosystems.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering teams and enterprise customers to architect, automate, and deploy resilient infrastructure stacks across bare\-metal, virtualized, and containerized environments.
   

  

**The Role**
**Architecture \& Deployment:** 
 Design and implement robust infrastructure solutions leveraging both container orchestration (Kubernetes) and traditional cloud computing platforms (OpenStack).
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** 
 Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of complex environments using Terraform and Ansible to ensure repeatable, error\-free deployments.
   

  

**Hybrid Virtualization:** 
 Bridge the gap between legacy VMs and modern containers by deploying and managing KVM and Kube\-virt solutions.
   

  

**Automation \& Scripting:** 
 Write clean, maintainable Python and Bash scripts to automate routine tasks, build internal tools, and integrate disparate systems.
   

  

**Infrastructure Management:** 
 Optimize and troubleshoot core compute resources, storage architectures, and networking layers to ensure high availability and performance.
   

  

**Technical Consultation:** 
 Act as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders, translating complex infrastructure requirements into scalable engineering designs.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Containerization \& Virtualization
   

  

**Kubernetes:** 
 Deep, production\-grade experience with K8s orchestration, architecture, and ecosystem tools.
   

  

**OpenStack:** 
 Proven track record of deploying, configuring, and managing OpenStack components.
   

  

**KVM \& Kube\-virt:** 
 Strong understanding of kernel\-based virtual machines (KVM) and experience running traditional virtual machines inside Kubernetes clusters using Kube\-virt.
   

  

 Automation \& IaC
   

  

**Scripting:** 
 Proficiency in
 **Python** 
 and
 **Bash** 
 for system automation and tool development.
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Hands\-on experience with
 **Terraform** 
 (for provisioning) and
 **Ansible** 
 (for configuration management).
   

  

 Core Infrastructure
   

  

**Compute:** 
 In\-depth knowledge of physical/virtual compute resource management and optimization.
   

  

**Storage:** 
 Strong understanding of storage technologies, including
 **Storage Area Networks (SAN)** 
 and
 **local disk technologies** 
 (NVMe, SSD, RAID configurations).
   

  

**Networking:** 
 Solid foundation in networking concepts, specifically
 **Layer 2 (L2\)** 
 and
 **Layer 3 (L3\)** 
 protocols, switching, routing, and software\-defined networking (SDN).
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Relevant certifications (e.g., CKA/CKAD, OpenStack Professional, AWS/GCP/Azure Architect).
   

  

 Experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Pre\-sales, Solutions Architecture, or Professional Services).
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug complex, distributed systems.
   

  

**About Us**
 We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

 We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: SCT_Tech Enablement_AI Architect_Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Team Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Team Lead to build and lead a team of software engineers developing a strategically important cloud\-based platform that enables customers to check and improve the accuracy of their X\-Rite color measurement devices.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role, combining hands\-on software development with technical leadership and people management. The role focuses on enabling team effectiveness, technical excellence, cloud\-native architecture, and continuous improvement in a global engineering environment.
   

  

 The team owns a modern web application built with TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, AWS, Lambda, Node.js, and serverless technologies, as well as a companion Qt/C\+\+ desktop application responsible for collecting and managing data that is integrated into the cloud platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers
* Hire, onboard, motivate, and coach team members, fostering engagement, growth, and a strong team culture
* Contribute hands\-on to software development, including design, implementation, code reviews, and technical problem solving — leveraging AI throughout the software development lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership and guide architectural decisions for both the cloud platform and associated desktop applications in collaboration with global engineering teams (US, Switzerland, India, Germany, Netherlands, North Macedonia)
* Own and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud\-native architectures on AWS
* Drive the evolution of frontend and backend systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, usability, and security
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, QA, data engineering, and application support teams to deliver customer value
* Facilitate Agile ways of working (Scrum/Kanban), supporting effective planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery
* Establish and continuously improve software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, cloud operations, observability, security, and effective usage of AI
* Ensure seamless integration between cloud services and desktop applications that contribute data to the platform
* Work closely with global stakeholders across India, Europe, and the US to align technical direction with product strategy
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence


**Required Qualifications \& Professional Knowledge**
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering
* 3\+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining modern web applications
* Several years of experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, and CSS
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native solutions on AWS or Azure
* Solid understanding of serverless architectures and services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and related cloud technologies
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems and defining application architectures
* Ability to analyze customer and business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Experience establishing engineering best practices including testing strategies, CI/CD, code quality, monitoring, and security
* Solid understanding of modern web application architecture and software design principles
* Experience collaborating with UX, Product Management, QA, and other engineering disciplines
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional teams
* Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or Kanban)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel (10%)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading teams developing cloud\-native SaaS or enterprise software platforms
* Experience with AWS services beyond Lambda and API Gateway, such as RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
* Experience working with data\-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams


**Nice to Have**
* Knowledge of desktop software development using C\+\+ and Qt
* Experience integrating desktop, edge, or device\-connected applications with cloud services
* Knowledge of color management, measurement systems, or hardware\-connected software solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* :5\+ years of experience delivering and evolving commercial software products throughout their lifecycle
* Experience balancing technical leadership, people leadership, and hands\-on software development responsibilities


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands\-on work with leadership responsibilities
* Passion for building high\-performing engineering teams and developing people
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross\-functional, global environment
* High learning agility and enthusiasm for modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI\-assisted development
* Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in a fast\-paced environment
* Effective communicator capable of aligning stakeholders across multiple functions and regions


 Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India ↔ US/EU)
   

  

 We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human\-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R\&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.
* The opportunity to work on business\-critical data platforms that support decision\-making across the company.
* Be part of building products that address real\-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America.
* A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges.
* The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction.
* Team leads are trusted to contribute not only technical expertise, but also vision, coaching, and leadership that help shape the future of our products and organization.


 Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross\-functional teamwork sets us apart.
   

  

 At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
   

  

**Unsolicited Assistance**
 We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nephrocare India is a premier renal care institute located in the heart of Kolkata, providing comprehensive treatment and support for a wide range of kidney\-related conditions. The institute offers holistic care for chronic and genetic kidney diseases, glomerular disorders, urological problems, and end\-stage renal disease, including dialysis and transplant services. Nephrocare is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratory and diagnostic facilities (Carepath India), an in\-house pharmacy (Caremed India), world\-class radiological equipment, and daycare surgical services such as AV fistula and perm cath creation at affordable cost. The organization focuses on delivering complete, cost\-effective renal care, complemented by a cafeteria serving renal\-friendly cuisines and a pharmacy that offers genuine medicines at attractive discounts. Under it's umbrella it has one 100 beded hospital running in full swing 'Vivacity multispeciality hospitals' and numerous clinic and hospitals are in pipeline.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will provide strategic and operational leadership for all technology initiatives at Nephrocare India, ensuring that digital solutions effectively support clinical care, diagnostics, patient experience, and business operations. This full\-time, on\-site role in Kolkata involves overseeing software and product development, defining and implementing IT strategy, and guiding technology architecture to align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements. The CTO will manage technology projects end\-to\-end, collaborate with clinical and administrative stakeholders, and ensure robust, secure, and scalable systems for electronic health records, diagnostic platforms, and internal tools. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include leading and mentoring technology teams, evaluating and integrating new technologies, managing vendor relationships, optimizing infrastructure and cybersecurity, and driving continuous improvement in digital workflows and data management.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong expertise in Software Development and Product Development, with experience delivering healthcare or enterprise\-grade applications.
* Demonstrated skills in IT Strategy and Architecture, including designing scalable, secure, and interoperable systems.
* Proven Project Management capabilities, overseeing complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from concept to deployment.
* Extensive leadership experience in a senior technology role, preferably as CTO, VP Engineering, or similar, in healthcare or related sectors.
* Solid understanding of healthcare workflows, health care software, Zoho, Tally, software migration, software integration, data privacy, and compliance standards (e.g., medical data security and local regulatory requirements).
* Ability to collaborate effectively with medical, operational, and executive teams, and to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with cloud platforms, cybersecurity best practices, data analytics, and integration of diagnostic or medical devices is highly beneficial.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

title: SAP - Basis  Senior Associate
description:

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will help clients optimize operational efficiency by analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This opportunity allows you to leverage your skills in SAP technology to enable clients to achieve their strategic objectives within our Finance Technology \- SAP Core ERP practice.

* Managing the installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
* Developing and maintaining SAP systems to optimize operational efficiency for clients

* At least a Bachelor's degree

* Oral and written proficiency in English required

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications aligned to SAP Technology and platform solutions, including SAP S/4HANA System Administration, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Security, or related technical architecture credentials
* Demonstrating proficiency in SAP HANA and SAP NetWeaver

* Excelling in strategic technology planning and process optimization
* Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud for data\-driven insights
* Embracing change and fostering innovation in complex environments

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|
 **Role Level:** 
 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.
